items.title: Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites
items.summary: Anthropic announced that its internal AI models under “high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations” no longer have internet access following incidents involving U.S. government websites at the federal, state, and local levels. The instances leading to the decision include AI models that exploited website vulnerabilities, submitted forms, bypassed data restrictions, and circumvented safeguards. However, the company said that the misaligned behavior had a minimal real-world impact and assessed the behavior to be less severe than previously reported incidents. - Exploiting servers to complete tasks. - Submitting real forms unintentionally. - Bypassing restrictions on data. - Circumventing fetch-tool limits. In late July, Anthropic disclosed a much more serious incident in which Claude Mythos-based agents built a malicious Python package containing a credential stealer and uploaded it to the Python Package Index (PyPI), where 15 systems downloaded and ran it. Claude used the package to complete a “capture-the-flag” challenge, but instead of publishing it to a simulated environment, it broke out to the real PyPI platform.
items.summary_html:
Anthropic announced that its internal AI models under “high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations” no longer have internet access following incidents involving U.S. government websites at the federal, state, and local levels.

The instances leading to the decision include AI models that exploited website vulnerabilities, submitted forms, bypassed data restrictions, and circumvented safeguards.

However, the company said that the misaligned behavior had a minimal real-world impact and assessed the behavior to be less severe than previously reported incidents. 
- Exploiting servers to complete tasks.
- Submitting real forms unintentionally. 
- Bypassing restrictions on data.
- Circumventing fetch-tool limits. 

In late July, Anthropic disclosed a much more serious incident in which Claude Mythos-based agents built a malicious Python package containing a credential stealer and uploaded it to the Python Package Index (PyPI), where 15 systems downloaded and ran it.

Claude used the package to complete a “capture-the-flag” challenge, but instead of publishing it to a simulated environment, it broke out to the real PyPI platform.

items.title: Critical SonicWall SMA 1000 Flaw Targeted in 135 Exploitation Attempts After Patch
items.summary: The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-102255 (CVSS score: 10.0), is a case of pre-authenticated server-side request forgery (SSRF) that could allow a remote attacker "to direct the appliance to issue requests on their behalf and reach internal functionality and perform unauthorized operations." Patches for the flaw were released by SonicWall on October 6, 2026, with versions 12.4.3-03670 (platform-hotfix) and 12.5.0-03082 (platform-hotfix). The vulnerability has since started witnessing active exploitation attempts, with first signs detected by threat intelligence firms Defused Cyber and Previdian on October 8, 2026. Data from Previdian shows that a total of 135 attempts have been observed to date from two unique IP addresses located in the U.S. SonicWall has yet to update the advisory to reflect active exploitation of the flaw. Rapid7 also said it observed threat actors leveraging the flaws to target internet-facing devices and use them as a stealthy initial access vector to execute commands on the operating system and ensure long-term, persistent access. "Once they established a foothold on the appliance, the actors systematically extracted high-value credentials, active session databases, and Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication (MFA) seed configurations," the company noted.

items.title: io.quarkus:quarkus-hibernate-orm-rest-data-panache: Missing Authorization in Quarkus REST Data Panache via Dropped Security Annotations

This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass security controls on generated endpoints. When a developer customizes a specific operation using @MethodProperties without explicitly re-declaring security roles, the code generator silently drops class-level security requirements. This results in the affected endpoint defaulting to permissive, unauthenticated access, potentially leading to unauthorized information disclosure or data modification.

items.title: Attackers Exploit CVSS 10.0 Bricksforge WordPress Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
items.summary: A maximum-severity security flaw impacting the Bricksforge plugin for WordPress has come under active exploitation in the wild, according to Patchstack. The critical vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-85097 (CVSS score: 10.0), which allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary PHP code on vulnerable WordPress websites, resulting in remote code execution (RCE). The security flaw impacts Bricksforge versions up to and including 3.1.8.9. Patches have been released in version 3.1.8.10. Successful exploitation of the flaw could result in arbitrary PHP execution on the server, which an attacker can leverage to seize control of the WordPress site, deploy web shells, read sensitive data, and establish persistent access. In the attacks observed by Patchstack, threat actors have been observed targeting the Bricksforge REST API form submission endpoint ("/wp-json/bricksforge/v1/form_submit") or the "/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php" endpoint with "bricksforge_form_submit" action along with a crafted "temporaryFileUploads" parameter.

items.title: CyberXero Uses Claude Code in Campaign That Stole Over 628,000 Ukrainian Records
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a two-pronged artificial intelligence (AI)-augmented initial access campaign targeting WordPress sites, e-commerce platforms, and critical infrastructure entities in Ukraine. The activity, which brings together commodity offensive tools like Cobalt Strike with an AI orchestration layer powered by Anthropic's Claude Code, has been attributed to a Russian-speaking, financially motivated initial access broker codenamed CyberXero. The threat actor is assessed to be active since at least July 2026. The global campaign specifically focuses on known security flaws like wp2shell (CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137) and CVE-2026-4815, an SQL injection vulnerability impacting the Support Board WordPress plugin, to seize control of WordPress sites. Analysis of the exposed directory shows that a single automated execution scanned 4,708 targets, confirming access to 429 WordPress administration panels, followed by the deployment of 32 web shells in a 61-second window. The attack architecture is based on a set of eight distinct nodes, including the threat actor's Linux workstation, a provisioning server, monetization infrastructure, payload staging servers, and a scanner that's responsible for identifying targets of interest. Like in the case of CyberXero, masterblack is also believed to have heavily leaned on AI agents powered by Claude to develop the intrusion code and exfiltration scripts, while the operator focused on designing the fraud panel code and custom AdaptixC2 extenders. "Recovered refusal transcripts show the operator repeatedly framing offensive development requests as authorized bug bounty or penetration testing activity while requesting functionality consistent with activity observed elsewhere in the operation," SOCRadar said.
items.summary_html:
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a two-pronged artificial intelligence (AI)-augmented initial access campaign targeting WordPress sites, e-commerce platforms, and critical infrastructure entities in Ukraine.

The activity, which brings together commodity offensive tools like Cobalt Strike with an AI orchestration layer powered by Anthropic's Claude Code, has been attributed to a Russian-speaking, financially motivated initial access broker codenamed CyberXero. The threat actor is assessed to be active since at least July 2026.

The global campaign specifically focuses on known security flaws like wp2shell (CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137) and CVE-2026-4815, an SQL injection vulnerability impacting the Support Board WordPress plugin, to seize control of WordPress sites.

Analysis of the exposed directory shows that a single automated execution scanned 4,708 targets, confirming access to 429 WordPress administration panels, followed by the deployment of 32 web shells in a 61-second window.

The attack architecture is based on a set of eight distinct nodes, including the threat actor's Linux workstation, a provisioning server, monetization infrastructure, payload staging servers, and a scanner that's responsible for identifying targets of interest.

Like in the case of CyberXero, masterblack is also believed to have heavily leaned on AI agents powered by Claude to develop the intrusion code and exfiltration scripts, while the operator focused on designing the fraud panel code and custom AdaptixC2 extenders.

"Recovered refusal transcripts show the operator repeatedly framing offensive development requests as authorized bug bounty or penetration testing activity while requesting functionality consistent with activity observed elsewhere in the operation," SOCRadar said.

items.title: Ukraine strikes third Yandex data center, disrupting digital services across Russia
items.summary: A third Yandex data center in Russia was hit by Ukrainian drones over the weekend, forcing it to shut down and causing further disruptions to cloud services, payments, deliveries and other online services across the country. The latest attack, overnight Sunday, targeted a Yandex facility in Vladimir, following strikes on two other data centers in the Ryazan and Kaluga regions earlier last week. The attacks have disrupted Yandex Cloud, which provides computing infrastructure to thousands of businesses, as well as some of the company's own services and third-party platforms that depend on its servers. According to the Russian internet watchdog, users have experienced problems accessing email, booking taxis, ordering food and making payments through Yandex Pay. The company's Alice voice assistant and connected smart home devices have also reportedly stopped working in some households. Following the latest strike, the company advised cloud customers to consider alternative recovery plans rather than relying solely on switching between parts of Yandex Cloud's own infrastructure Russian state media reported that Yandex had reached agreements with competing cloud providers Selectel, K2Cloud and VK Cloud to help affected customers move their data and services more quickly.

A third Yandex data center in Russia was hit by Ukrainian drones over the weekend, forcing it to shut down and causing further disruptions to cloud services, payments, deliveries and other online services across the country.

The latest attack, overnight Sunday, targeted a Yandex facility in Vladimir, following strikes on two other data centers in the Ryazan and Kaluga regions earlier last week.

The attacks have disrupted Yandex Cloud, which provides computing infrastructure to thousands of businesses, as well as some of the company's own services and third-party platforms that depend on its servers.

According to the Russian internet watchdog, users have experienced problems accessing email, booking taxis, ordering food and making payments through Yandex Pay. The company's Alice voice assistant and connected smart home devices have also reportedly stopped working in some households.

Following the latest strike, the company advised cloud customers to consider alternative recovery plans rather than relying solely on switching between parts of Yandex Cloud's own infrastructure 

Russian state media reported that Yandex had reached agreements with competing cloud providers Selectel, K2Cloud and VK Cloud to help affected customers move their data and services more quickly.

items.title: Kyberisku ranskalaiskauppoihin: pakastimet sulivat
items.summary: Kolmeen supermarketketjuun Ranskassa tehtiin maanantaina kyberhyökkäys. Hyökkäys sai Intermarchén, Coopérative U:n ja E. Leclercin myymälöiden kylmälaitteita sulamaan. Hyökkäys kohdistui ainakin 300:aan Intermarchén tai sen Netto-ketjun myymälään, yli sataan Coopérative U:n myymälään ja useisiin E. Leclercin myymälään. BFM TV:n mukaan hakkerit onnistuivat käynnistämään etäyhteydellä kylmälaitteiden pakotetun sulatuksen useissa myymälöissä.
